verdict.rationale: Agora's own marketing copy claims its platform supports phone calls, reaching users on any device or channel. That points to some telephony reach, but the pack contains no documentation of SIP trunking, PSTN dial-in, or dial-out into a session. missing for 10: documented SIP integration, PSTN dial-in flow, outbound dial-out API, setup docs and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, phone callers join a session through documented SIP or PSTN dial-in and dial-out

citations.quote: Supporting mobile apps, web, and phone calls; reaching users on any device or channel.
